title: Identifying Driver-Cab Controls
description: Locate the master handle, understand neutral and power detents, and distinguish controls from indications.

steps.instruction: Locate the master control handle (not the speedometer) and select N. Identify the neutral indication.
Locate P2 on the same handle and observe the selected position as a request for traction, not a speed setting.
Return the handle to N and observe the controller indication.

learningObjective: Recognize which cab equipment requests motion and which equipment reports the response.
operatingConditions: Begin at standstill with the monitored passenger doors closed.
This exercise uses the eight-position combined controller of the teaching cab.
expectedObservations: N means no traction or service-braking request from the handle.
P2 is a power request, not a prescribed speed; observe the speedometer.
The handle returns to N without automatically stopping a moving train.
debriefQuestions: What is the difference between the master handle and the speedometer?
Why should the driver check indications after moving a controller?
